title: Neon Sorceresses of the Spires
description: Three women with long black hair stand in a futuristic fantasy cityscape under a purple and green aurora sky. One kneels on a glowing circuit-patterned floor touching a golden symbol, another stands holding a glowing white staff with a dove-like creature, and the third holds a crystalline glowing object while wearing an elaborate silver braid and metallic armor.
prompt: Three beautiful women with long black hair in a dramatic fantasy cyberpunk city with towering striped spires and floating dragon-like creatures. One woman kneels on a glowing circuit board floor, another stands in a form-fitting purple metallic suit holding a glowing staff with a white bird, the third wears ornate silver armor with a long braid and holds a glowing crystalline object. Purple and green aurora borealis in the sky, dramatic lighting, mist and clouds, highly detailed digital painting.
